RF.location: Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rates; 10 Yr column
RF.note: 5.15% nominal Treasury yield used as an unadjusted risk-free proxy.

ERP.location: Implied ERP; trailing 12 months with adjusted payout
ERP.note: 4.41% monthly estimate carried forward to valuation date. No sovereign default-spread adjustment.

BETA.location: US Air Transport; 23 firms; Unlevered beta column
BETA.note: 0.70, not the cash-corrected 0.76. Sector cash exposure retained as an approximation.

SPREAD.location: ICE BofA rating-group option-adjusted spreads via FRED
SPREAD.note: BBB 1.11%; BB 1.86%; B 3.44%. Each company's exact series is recorded separately. Index OAS is measured against a Treasury spot curve; adding it to the 10-year Treasury yield is a practical maturity approximation, not a company bond YTM. Observation date is not the FRED publication date; this is a retrospective valuation-date estimate.

TAX.location: Group modelling assumption; supporting tax screenshots in sources/tax
TAX.note: B-selected normalised marginal tax assumption: 21% federal plus 3 percentage points net state/local effect. It is not a common reported tax rate or a confirmed team agreement.

FINANCIALS.note: Member A's dataset. Book adjusted debt proxies market debt; equity is market capitalisation. Individual market prices have not been independently reverified.

SPREAD_BB.note: 1.86%, stored as 0.0186; BB group proxy for UAL and ALK.
